item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:45 HKT 08/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect Guangdong today and tomorrow. A relatively dry easterly airstream will gradually affect the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. It will be windier over the region during the weekend. An anticyclone aloft is expected to cover southern China during the weekend and early next week. The weather will be mainly fine over the region.

Weather: Mainly fine. Becoming cloudy later. Isolated showers at night.
